Messages.Author: beslin igor
Messages.Body:
Name: Charnas the Imp

Cardtype: Retainer
Clan: Tremere
Cost: 1 blood
Unique demon with 1 life.
Put Charnas on any minion (employing Charnas is a +1 stealth  action if that minion is controlled by another Methuselah). The minion with this retainer takes 1 damage during his or her unlock phase. Charnas is immune to damage from that minion. If the minion is burned, his or her controlling Methuselah can put Charnas on any minion.

I'm interested in the following situation: Vampire Methuselah A put Charnas in minion Methuselah B,if this minion of Methuselah B burned,so he can move Charnas on any other minion or can chose burn charnas,because text in Carnas said can.
But what happen if Methuselah B is ousted,does he get the time to move Charnas on another minion?

Messages.Author: thelonius reloaded
Messages.Body:
I think correct interpretation is:
You get ousted -> you are no longer in the game -> you can't make decisions about the game

Lurking in the underground of Bologna, Italy

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Rulebook; " If you are ousted, all the cards you control are removed from the game."

Vampires controlled by B, as well as Charnas, are removed from the game when B is ousted.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director
